name: staging-points
status: DRAFT — rover limits are Role B assumptions, not agreed flight rules
source: Derived from HiRISE 1 m DTM slope and roughness (NASA/JPL/University of Arizona)
caveats: Draft for the walking EVA leg: rover slope/roughness limits are not agreed by the team yet.
Straight-line walks; walk_km is ground distance on the Mars sphere, not path length over the relief.
Max slope on the walk includes isolated 1 m DTM spikes; check the slope overlay before trusting a single high value.
Not ground-truthed: no rover has operated in Arcadia Planitia.

assumptions: Rover parking slope < 15° (ASSUMPTION, Role B; Apollo 15 Mission Report §9.8.3: LRV roll instability approached on 15° slopes, parked rover slid downslope). Not agreed by the team.
Rover parking roughness < 0.25 m RMS on 5 m cells (ASSUMPTION, Role B; LRV ground clearance 36 cm, NASA NSSDC). Not agreed by the team. The 1 m DTM cannot see single rocks.
Each 10 m cell takes the worst (max) slope and roughness inside it; a spot needs a 2 × 2 block of parkable cells (≥ 20 × 20 m).
Walk-back ≤ 2 km straight-line ground distance on the Mars sphere (config.yaml walk_back_max_km); spots closer than 100 m to the POI are excluded (ASSUMPTION: keep the rover off the science target).
Walk path = straight line to the POI on the 1 m slope; the suit limit is 20° (config.yaml slope_max_deg). Real walks would detour around steep sections.
Rank by walk_km × (1 + 10 × share of the walk ≥ 20°); alternatives at least 250 m apart.
Slope and roughness come from the 1 m HiRISE DTM (vertical precision ~tens of cm); sub-metre rocks need the 0.25 m imagery.
